title: Editor-review stage bot: first slice of the editor agent
description: Generic procedures/newsroom/editor_review.tac stage bot (design: editor agents first slice). Reads the version, linked References, brief (or doctrine), editorial check; judges eight acceptance criteria; writes Item.metadata.editorReview; returns {version, hold, reason} (approve advances to typesetting, revise/reframe holds and the engine raises a flag). Never publishes, never writes Messages. Includes the runner template grant for the Anth.us newsroom (change set not run) and docs/editor-agents.md section. Not enabled on any site: register, automation and change set are operator steps.
